source_title: German, Slovak nationals die of suspected electrocution in Bengaluru 5-star hotel pool
source_excerpt: BENGALURU: Two foreign nationals, a German and a Slovakian, died following suspected electrocution in the swimming pool of Conrad Hotel in Bengaluru on Friday evening.Two others, including an American tourist and a hotel employee, were injured while attempting to rescue them.The incident took place on the third floor of the hotel in Ulsoor.The deceased have been identified as Alexander Maximilian Theiss (57), a German national and Lufthansa crew member, and Juraj Horvat (45), a Slovak national who worked as a project manager with IBM.Mathew Desantis (41), an American national staying at the hotel as a tourist, and Rahul Tiwari (28), a pool attendant and lifeguard employed at the hotel, were injured while trying to rescue the two men.All four were rushed to Manipal Hospital, where the two injured survivors are undergoing treatment. They are reported to be out of danger.Police have registered a case and launched an investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident.According to Dr Mabel Vasnaik, HOD of Emergency Medicine, Manipal Hospitals, while Theiss was brought dead, the doctors tried resuscitating Horvat, but could not succeed, and he was eventually declared dead too.âThe cause of death was electrocution,â Dr Vasnaik said.Along with them, Mathew Desantis, 41, a US national and Rahul Tiwari, a 28-year-old pool attendant and lifeguard from the Conrad Hotel were also brought to the hospital.Desantis reportedly detected a current when he was swimming in the pool and swam back to safety while Tiwari jumped in to save the other two members in the pool.âThe US national had a headache yesterday, but as of today, he is stable and will mostly be discharged by evening. The pool attendant who jumped in to save them is also stable, but has manifested some pain today. hi_body:
बेंगलुरु के उल्लूर स्थित कॉनराड होटल के स्विमिंग पूल में शुक्रवार शाम संदिग्ध रूप से करंट लगने के कारण दो विदेशी नागरिकों की मौत हो गई। इस घटना के दौरान बचाव का प्रयास करते हुए दो अन्य लोग घायल हो गए हैं।

## घटना का विवरण
* **स्थान:** कॉनराड होटल, उल्लूर, बेंगलुरु।
* **घटना का दिन:** शुक्रवार शाम।
* **हताहत:** दो की मृत्यु और दो घायल।

## मृतकों और घायलों की पहचान
रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, मृतकों की पहचान अलेक्जेंडर मैक्सिमिलियन थीस (57), जो जर्मनी के नागरिक और लुफ्थांसा के क्रू मेंबर थे, और जुराज होर्वत (45), जो स्लोवाक नागरिक और आईबीएम में प्रोजेक्ट मैनेजर थे, के रूप में की गई है।

बचाव कार्य के दौरान घायल हुए व्यक्तियों में शामिल हैं:
* **मैथ्यू डिसेंटिस (41):** एक अमेरिकी पर्यटक, जिन्होंने पूल में करंट महसूस होने पर खुद को सुरक्षित बाहर निकाल लिया था।
* **राहुल तिवारी (28):** होटल के पूल अटेंडेंट और लाइफगार्ड, जिन्होंने अन्य लोगों को बचाने के लिए पूल में छलांग लगाई थी।

## चिकित्सा सहायता
सभी चारों व्यक्तियों को मणिपाल अस्पताल ले जाया गया। मणिपाल अस्पताल की आपातकालीन चिकित्सा प्रमुख डॉ. मेबल वासनिक ने बताया कि अलेक्जेंडर थीस को मृत अवस्था में लाया गया था, जबकि जुराज होर्वत को बचाने के प्रयास विफल रहे और उन्हें भी मृत घोषित कर दिया गया। जीवित बचे दोनों लोगों की स्थिति स्थिर है और उन्हें जल्द ही अस्पताल से छुट्टी मिलने की उम्मीद है।

## जांच की स्थिति
स्थानीय पुलिस ने मामला दर्ज कर लिया है और घटना की परिस्थितियों की जांच शुरू कर दी है। अधिकारी यह पता लगाने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं कि पूल में करंट कैसे फैला। इस मामले में अधिकृत जानकारी के लिए बेंगलुरु पुलिस द्वारा जारी बयानों का संदर्भ लें।

en_body:
Two foreign nationals have died following a suspected electrocution incident at the swimming pool of the Conrad Hotel in Ulsoor, Bengaluru, on Friday evening. Two other individuals sustained injuries while attempting to provide assistance during the event.

## Incident Overview
* **Location:** Conrad Hotel, Ulsoor, Bengaluru.
* **Date of Incident:** Friday evening.
* **Casualties:** Two deaths and two injuries confirmed.

## Details of the Deceased and Injured
According to reports, the deceased have been identified as Alexander Maximilian Theiss (57), a German national and Lufthansa crew member, and Juraj Horvat (45), a Slovak national employed as a project manager at IBM. 

Two others were injured while attempting to rescue the victims:
* **Mathew Desantis (41):** An American tourist who reported feeling an electric current while in the pool and subsequently swam to safety.
* **Rahul Tiwari (28):** A hotel pool attendant and lifeguard who intervened to assist the victims.

## Medical Response
The victims and injured parties were transported to Manipal Hospital. Dr. Mabel Vasnaik, HOD of Emergency Medicine at Manipal Hospitals, stated that Alexander Theiss was declared brought dead, and despite resuscitation efforts, Juraj Horvat could not be revived. Regarding the survivors, Dr. Vasnaik noted that both individuals are currently stable and expected to be discharged following routine medical evaluations.

## Investigation Status
Local authorities have registered a case and initiated an investigation to determine the exact circumstances that led to the suspected electrocution. Officials are currently analyzing the pool environment and equipment to verify the source of the electrical fault. For official updates, the public is advised to follow statements issued by the Bengaluru Police department.
en_title: Two Foreign Nationals Die in Suspected Electrocution at Bengaluru Five-Star Hotel
